compiler.requires: Linux JDK 21: /bin/sh, mkdir and javac 21 runnable as UID 65532 with a read-only root, no network and tmpfs /work and /tmp.

build.requires: Linux JDK 21 (javac, not only a JRE): /bin/sh, cp, find and grep runnable as UID 65532 offline. Maven is not taken from the image; the trusted host Maven installation is mounted read-only at /maven.
